name: DKCTF Hard Mode – real independent P2 selector
notes: Keeps the independently active P2 path available during Hard Mode initialization. The selector writes mRuntimeData.Char_P2 before initLevelTransition; the stock native block at 0x352C74 then reloads runtime data ID 0x66 and replaces the temporary automatic partner. The failed 0x1E700C NOP is intentionally not included.

entries.description: Do not clear the +0x26AF state byte that gates the independent P2 path during Hard Mode initialization.
Preserve an already active P2 slot bit while the temporary automatic partner is initialized.
